evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

criteria.label: Eating excess and enjoyment
criteria.definition: Often eating too much and loving eating, including enjoyment without demonstrated excess.
criteria.high_evidence: Often eats beyond enough or loves eating as an activity.
criteria.low_evidence: Rarely eats too much and/or has little enjoyment of eating itself.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Enjoyment does not prove loss of control. Health, body size, food access, diet rules and diagnosis are not inferred; opposing enjoyment/excess subcontents require explanation.

criteria.label: Not understanding own actions
criteria.definition: Doing things without knowing why one did them.
criteria.high_evidence: Reports own actions whose reasons remain unclear to self.
criteria.low_evidence: Generally understands own reasons for ordinary actions.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. This is a literal broad item, not necessarily a craving or rashness claim. Memory loss/compulsion/diagnosis are not inferred. O3 insight interest is distinct from actual understood motives.

criteria.label: Actions followed by regret
criteria.high_evidence: Repeatedly wishes one had not done own actions.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Outcome disappointment alone is not regret about acting. Retained even without an urge or lack of planning; N3 low mood and C6 rashness are not prerequisites.

criteria.label: Craving control, temptation and bouts of excess
criteria.definition: Binges, overindulgence and difficulty resisting/controling urges versus restraint.
criteria.high_evidence: Has bouts of excess, overindulges, cannot easily resist temptation or control cravings.
criteria.low_evidence: Rarely overindulges and easily resists temptations or controls cravings.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Not broad low C5 task initiation, general impulsivity, addiction diagnosis or moral failing. One craving/binge span supports one grade, not several item-count votes.

criteria.label: Affordable spending and splurges
criteria.definition: Overspending and splurging versus keeping purchases affordable and not splurging.
criteria.high_evidence: Spends beyond means or splurges on discretionary purchases.
criteria.low_evidence: Keeps spending within means or rarely splurges.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Affordable splurges can support the splurge subcontent while contradicting overspending; do not silently require financial harm. Wealth, generosity, poverty or inability to buy alone is ambiguous.

boundary_controls.definition: Coherent unfavorable portrayed behavior is not actual experimental instruction failure or severe incoherence.
External constraint or imposed role alone is ambiguous; explicit habitual target evidence can coexist.

N5 is urge/indulgence-centered, not general low conscientiousness. Literal eating enjoyment, unexplained actions and later regret remain explicit content without forcing every instance to involve temptation.
Do not replace target evidence with moral worth, politeness, helpfulness or verbosity.
